test_title: PYST 70: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On 23 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘BOTH’ is written as ‘DQVJ’ and ‘DARE’ is written as ‘FCTG’ How will ‘WILL’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png] 

The logic followed here is:

‘BOTH’ is written as ‘DQVJ’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/835df8bc97750c8d836fe728fffbfafd8903bd1a1b99b5ee4124ada8aede7952.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31d8fd4d7cd8c9ba60bb4cd615d6a23a51466d44de6e6b6772ff2de6cace0203.png] 

‘DARE’ is written as ‘FCTG’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f03a451172b7928c24c973b2d221d368c0e12858cd0ff86d6fcf36158fbbd2e.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/412c499977861c6c120a4782314515124fe84da597b4dd736efc609a8a6f80ff.png] 

Similarly, ‘**WILL**’ will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f826f48bec701e3ac6b977e40e858de7c92d461c8fca988f7c8fbf1053a8cee.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17c214bb11f574eb6c4571223da522ed272c41e52697150d81c0c2f163fee1af.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"YKNN".**
